segments.text: 大家好,今天我们评审一下新版设置页面的设计稿。
segments.speaker: S1

segments.text: 我先说一下,现在的设置像太多了,用户很难找到通知开关。
segments.speaker: S2

segments.text: 同意我们把通知相关的选项放到第一屏,其他高级选项折叠起来。
segments.speaker: S1

segments.text: 好,这样改动不大,我下周二之前把新的交互稿发给大家。
segments.speaker: S2

segments.text: 另外,深色模式下宜有几个按钮的对比度不够。
segments.speaker: S1

segments.text: 这个我也注意到了你能不能整理一份需要调整的颜色清淡
segments.speaker: S2

segments.text: 可以我周四之前整理好颜色清淡
segments.speaker: S1

segments.text: 还有开发那边问我们什么时候能定稿
segments.speaker: S2

segments.text: 我们定在下周五定稿
segments.speaker: S1

segments.text: 定稿之后请测试团队在两周内完成可用性测试
segments.speaker: S1

segments.text: 好的那就这么定了
segments.speaker: S2

summary: 新版设置页面的设计稿需要调整通知相关的选项和深色模式下的按钮对比度。
定稿日期为下周五，测试团队需在两周内完成可用性测试。

segments.text: 我们开始这个sprint的planning吧,先看 backlog 理优先级最高的三个ticket。
segments.speaker: S1

segments.text: 第一个是login页面的bug,用户在password输错之后没有提示。
segments.speaker: S2

segments.text: 这个比较急,你今天能fix吗?
segments.speaker: S1

segments.text: 可以,我今天下班之前fix这个bug,然后提交code review。
segments.speaker: S2

segments.text: 好,第二个是搜索的performance,现在要等三秒多
segments.speaker: S1

segments.text: 我觉得要加一个cache,不过需要后端同事一起看
segments.speaker: S2

segments.text: 那我来约后端团队,这周三开个meeting讨论cache的方案
segments.speaker: S1

segments.text: 第三个是onboarding的新流程,design还没有final
segments.speaker: S2

segments.text: 那onboarding我们放到下一个sprint,这个sprint只做前两个
segments.speaker: S1

segments.text: OK,我同意,我会在周五之前更新sprint board
segments.speaker: S2

summary: 优先级最高的三个ticket分别是修复login页面的bug、优化搜索性能和更新onboarding新流程。
第二个ticket（搜索性能）需要加一个cache，但需后端同事共同讨论。
第三个ticket（onboarding新流程）将放到下一个sprint。
第一个ticket（login页面的bug）将在今天修复并提交代码审查。
decisions: 这个sprint只做前两个ticket，onboarding新流程放到下一个sprint。

segments.text: Morning, let's keep this short, the main topic is the mobile release that was planned for this Friday
segments.speaker: S1

segments.text: Right, the build is ready, but the offline sync still loses some changes when the network comes back
segments.speaker: S2

segments.text: How long do you need to fix that?
segments.speaker: S1

segments.text: About two days, I will fix the offline sync bar and push a new build by Wednesday
segments.speaker: S2

segments.text: Okay, then we move the release from Friday to next Tuesday, is everyone fine with that?
segments.speaker: S1

segments.text: Yes, Tuesday works for me
segments.speaker: S2

segments.text: Good, that is decided. I will update the release notes and share them with the support team by Thursday
segments.speaker: S1

segments.text: Could you also ask the design team for the new pictures for the App Store?
segments.speaker: S2

segments.text: Sure, I will ask them today
segments.speaker: S1

segments.text: One more thing, the crash rate on older phones went up last week. I would like the test team to run the full regression suite on the new build before Monday
segments.speaker: S2

segments.text: Agreed, let's meet again on Monday to confirm the release
segments.speaker: S1

summary: The mobile release was planned for Friday but moved to Tuesday due to offline sync issues.
S1 will update the release notes and share them with the support team by Thursday.
decisions: Move the mobile release from Friday to next Tuesday.

action_items.task: Update the release notes and share with the support team
Ask the design team for new pictures for the App Store
Run the full regression suite on the new build
